latestHairCandidateStatus: r287 extends the r279 384-card dynamic proxy with three explicit layers: a 758-vertex matte scalp underlayer, the 18,432-vertex dynamic alpha-card layer with safe grouped tip shortening, and a 768-vertex soft hairline transition layer. Independent audits pass: all six dynamic frames have zero main-card penetration and 1.430mm/5.058mm peak mean/P95 motion; scalp and hairline layers maintain minimum body clearances of 0.894mm and 1.389mm at frames 1/33/61; owned materials, UVs and 15 bones pass. Strict hair score is 55/100 because tiled crown ridges, straight side silhouettes and weak outer breakup remain non-human. Website promotion remains forbidden.
latestHairMaterialStudy: r192 Aevrynd-owned satin EEVEE branch derived from the offline CC0 r129 node group; geometry parity and 11-shot visual review passed; strict hero-hair gate remains open
latestHairPerformanceResearch: r227-r272 density and thin cards; r273-r279 wide-card dynamics; r280-r287 scalp underlayer, safe grouped tips and projected hairline transition
latestHairPerformanceResearchStatus: r287 adds explicit runtime scalp, dynamic card and hairline layers while retaining 384 primary cards. The main dynamic, owned-material and per-layer body-clearance audits all pass. The next limitation is authored crown/outer silhouette design, not collision or binding.
latestEyeCandidateStatus: r257 is rejected because saturated wetlines and oversized caruncles read as red eyeliner and beads. r258 rebuilds these layers at subtle scale and passes the frame 1/20 24-layer head-binding audit with zero brow-root penetration and negligible head-space drift. It remains a technical candidate because the eyelid aperture and facial anatomy are still below hero quality.
latestFaceCandidateStatus: r258 preserves the r256 face and adds restrained independent lid wetlines, tear menisci and caruncles. Body deformation and all tracked face-layer attachment checks pass at frames 1 and 20. Strict face quality remains below release level; adult identity, eyelid anatomy, asymmetry and regional skin response still require sculpting.
latestSkinCandidateStatus: r252-r256 replace the stretched full-body procedural field with object-space isotropic macro tone and pore noise, smooth all 10,590 base polygons and reduce overexposure. Vertical striping is removed. Regional vascular, oil, dry and pigmentation maps are still missing, so strict skin quality remains below hero level.
latestRejectedExperiment: r280 rigid scalp binding, r281 weights without parent transform, r282 ambiguous scalp boundary, r283 early tip shortening, r285 dense hairline material
latestRejectedReason: r280-r281 displaced the scalp under yaw; r282 retained one invalid boundary vertex; r283 moved mid-card vertices into the body; r285 created dark forehead spikes. r284, r286 and r287 correct these failures.
latestBrowResearch: r211-r216 component inspection, layer isolation, root-order rejection, surface sampling and authored anatomical direction-field sweeps
latestBrowResearchStatus: No r211-r216 experiment passes the strict normal-distance gain gate. Existing r210 density supplies the arch but is flat close; original fibers are sparse and regular. Root-order rotation creates curls/spikes, duplicates are negligible, surface sampling reads as parallel brush hair, and short authored micro-fill disappears at normal distance. No blend candidate was promoted.
latestFaceMaterialResearch: r217-r219 nasal/perioral displacement and skin optical-response sweeps
latestFaceMaterialResearchStatus: r217 moves up to 4,695 evaluated vertices with 1.156mm maximum displacement but independent lip/nostril layers and the current skin response suppress the intended planes; stronger motion would raise collision risk. r219 makes pores more visible by lowering roughness and raising specular/SSS/coat, but all variants become oily or plastic. Both studies are rejected and r210 remains the face candidate.
latestMouthResearch: r220-r226 authored-state isolation, integrated lip volume/color, anatomical vermilion masking and local retopology studies
latestMouthResearchStatus: r220 confirms that r210 already hides the legacy Lip_Upper, Lip_Lower and Mouth_WetLine shells, so the formal mouth is the continuous 41,692-vertex body surface. r221-r223 show that simple displacement and color cannot resolve the flat upper vermilion. r224 exposes triangle-shaped POINT-color interpolation boundaries. r225 produces a swollen ridge instead of a natural lip plane. r226 proves local subdivision can add 5,805 vertices while preserving all 21 armature groups and zero unweighted points, but its rectangular boundary creates visible commissure and nasolabial shading dents. All variants are rejected and r210 remains the face candidate.

latestHairScalpCandidateStatus: r163 derives a clean scalp shell from the same shaped body surface, copies all 21 skin-weight groups and Armature deformation, excludes the concave temple crease, and keeps 1.2mm authored clearance. Its 2,626 vertices/2,438 faces and r162 177,353-point pruned curly layer pass frame 1/20 collision checks against body and all three clothing solids. It reduces crown exposure but still fails strict overall hair appearance, so it is a scalp deformation/collision technical candidate only.
latestFoundationCandidateStatus: r249-r251 establish the rigged CC0 body foundation. r252 replaces stretched Generated-coordinate skin noise with isotropic object-space tone and pore fields and adds separate cornea layers. r253 corrects distorted cylinder-cap iris UVs with explicit radial UVs and reduces oversized catchlights. r254 and r255 are strict visual rejects for comb-like and parallel-line brows. r256 rebuilds 406 short stochastic eyebrow fibers per side plus clustered upper/lower lashes. The r256 body deformation audit passes across 169,362 evaluated vertices and 338,720 edges; the face-layer audit passes at frames 1 and 20 with zero penetrating brow roots, valid head-bone binding and no material head-space drift. Strict overall face quality is about 55/100, so it remains a technical candidate.

latestFaceResearchStatus: r258 is the current CC0 face technical node. It passes the r251 body deformation audit and the expanded 24-layer frame 1/20 face attachment audit.
